Vision Government Solutions

|

Hopkinton,RI

|

Welcome

Welcome to the Town of Hopkinton, RI Online Assessment Database.

Shown on this site are assessments of all taxable and exempt properties based on 100% of fair market value as of December 31, 2025.

The Town of Hopkinton and Vision Government Solutions would like to thank the residents of Hopkinton for their patience and cooperation throughout the 2025 Revaluation project.

Real Property Tax Rate: $12.44

Tangible Property Tax Rate: $14.66

Please note that assessed values do not reflect any exemptions, which will be applied to the final assessments.

Though every effort is made to produce and publish the most accurate information available, there is no guarantee the information is free from errors or inaccuracies. Property owners are encouraged to check the information for accuracy and contact the Assessor with any discrepancies.

Search Tips: When searching by map and lot, there are three blocks. The first block is for the map number, which requires three digits, so if you are searching for map 2 use 002. The second block is for condominium unit number, which requires three digits, so if searching for unit 21 use 021. If it is not a condominium, enter 000. The third block is for the lot number. This is a five character block, so if searching for lot 23A use 0023A.
